title: Hydration

nodes.text: Replace fluids and electrolytes lost through perspiration

evidence.source_text: Dehydration will occur if fluids and electrolytes lost through perspiration are not replaced.

nodes.text: Is physical activity prolonged or intensive?

evidence.source_text: It is important to remain hydrated, especially during periods of prolonged or intensive physical activity.

nodes.text: Maintain recommended water to electrolyte ratio of 2:1

evidence.source_text: The recommended ratio of water to electrolytes is 2:1.
The use of an agency approved electrolyte drink/powder is important to maintaining good hydration levels.

nodes.text: Drink up to 1200 ml of water and 600 ml of electrolyte drink per hour

evidence.source_text: Depending on workload you should be drinking up to 1200 ml of water and 600 ml of an agency approved electrolyte replacement drink/powder per hour.

nodes.text: Ensure all personnel maintain fluid intake during shift

evidence.source_text: It is important that all personnel remain hydrated by maintaining their fluid intake during the shift.
